primary_title: Glia-to-neuron transfer of miRNAs via extracellular vesicles: a new mechanism underlying inflammation-induced synaptic alterations
decision_basis: The primary study reports inflammatory microglia-derived EV enrichment of miR-146a-5p and EV-dependent delivery to neurons, with a Renilla sensor and loss of transfer after miR-146a-5p inhibition or EV-neuron contact blockade.
